rationale_doc: v0.7.0-alpha topology is 2 ai-memory droplets + 1 postgres+AGE droplet. NODE3_IP / NODE4_IP fall back to NODE2_IP via Harness.from_env, so any scenario whose oracle requires THREE distinct daemons (3-way distinct write/quorum, isolation between two peers, SIGSTOP one of three peers) cannot be validated in this topology. Those are deferred to v0.7.1 when a 3rd ai-memory droplet is added.

wave4_pre_stage.summary: Wave 4 = live A2A re-validation on postgres-backed daemons. S77-S82 are added pre-stage for Continuation 3 (--store-url postgres:// support). They self-skip when A2A_BACKEND_KIND=sqlite, preserving the existing 56/68 GREEN baseline on the legacy sqlite topology.

q_track_in_scope.rationale: Q track has 4 distinct GPU openclaw daemons (NODE3=openclaw-3, NODE4=openclaw-4, no alias). S14 SIGSTOP+SIGCONT cycle on openclaw-3 is now safe — test isolates the chosen peer from quorum.
Q track NODE3 is openclaw-3 (distinct daemon). S25 ssh-shifts its clock +300s; harm is contained to that node and audit-chain drift is the explicit oracle.
Q track NODE3 is openclaw-3 (distinct daemon). S39 SIGSTOP for delta-since test isolates that peer from sync; recovery on SIGCONT is the oracle.
